div.div: 5 تشوّط الفَرَسَ , [in the CK, ↓ شَوَّطَ , but as this, in the manner in which it is there mentioned, is a needless repetition, being implied, if correct, it is doubtless a mistranscription,] He continued to drive, or urge on, the horse, until he was tired, or fatigued. (K, * TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
